description: x_no_call: a text reply without the Record call. xai/grok-4 on openai_chat. Schema Rec (corpus:Rec), name Record. Strategy forced_tool. Request: tools [Record the function-tool parameters of Rec]; tool_choice {type: "function", function: {name: "Record"}}; parallel_tool_calls false. Expected: plan.parse(response) throws MissingToolCallError("the reply did not call the Record tool; call it with the answer").
